stories.title: Service Interface and Contract Definition
stories.description: Define formal service boundaries, interfaces, and contracts for the 4-layer modular monolith (facades, application, domain, infrastructure). Specify input/output schemas and interaction rules between 2 facades and 9 services.

stories.title: Core Service Refactor Implementation
stories.description: Refactor existing domain logic into defined service modules aligned with ARCH-001 (find_care, evaluate_care, shared services). Ensure separation of concerns and removal of cross-layer leakage.

stories.title: Facade Layer Alignment and API Routing
stories.description: Align existing facades (find_care_facade, evaluate_care_facade) with new service boundaries and enforce contract-driven routing through tool_router and FastAPI entrypoints.

stories.title: Integration Wiring and Dependency Validation
stories.description: Wire all services, facades, and infrastructure components through main.py ensuring correct dependency injection and runtime composition مطابق ARCH-001 design.

stories.title: Refactor Regression and Integration Test Suite
stories.description: Develop and update unit and integration tests to validate refactored architecture, ensuring parity with pre-refactor behavior and no regression in tool routing, service outputs, or safety flows.
